Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: All participants related to a patient with familial combined hyperlipidemia
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a genetic diagnosis of familial hypercholesterolemia (heterozygous LDLR c.1444G>A mutation) but no explicit documentation of familial combined hyperlipidemia in any relative. The paternal father's sudden cardiac death at age 62 is noted, but this does not confirm familial combined hyperlipidemia in a family member.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No exclusion criteria were provided in the clinical trial description.

Recap: Patient has familial hypercholesterolemia but lacks documented familial combined hyperlipidemia in a relative, failing the sole inclusion criterion.
